title: fix(ci): merge-queue-triage stacksFor() walks the stack through green queue groups
body:
<!-- claude-projects-attribution: {"github_login":"os-steve"} -->
_Requested by **Steve** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_01FdL1XeUyvVNxLreh3F4Qi9?thread=cmsg_01FdL1XeUyvVNxLreh3F4Qi9KyXC7PqZzbzLfU36Sd9Xoo)_
Fixes #26265
Clause-②: no
Metadata-protocol: none

⛔ **Tier H (governed: `.github/workflows/**`).** This PR stays a draft. Landing waits for an approved review from a `GOVERNED_APPROVERS` account; no seat readies it, queues it or arms auto-merge.

## What changed

`stacksFor()` in `.github/workflows/merge-queue-triage.yml` used to union two victims only when one victim's queue base was another victim's queue head. A victim stacked on another victim **through green, non-victim queue groups** therefore read as an independent hit. On #26247 that turned one deterministic break (#26064's queued commit) into "2 independent hits".

- **The walk.** From each victim's base, `stacksFor()` now walks base to head through every `merge_group` run already indexed in `stackEdges` (green groups included). It unions with any other victim whose head the chain reaches. The index was already in hand, so this adds no API calls.
- **The two rules from before are unchanged.** Matching is still full-sha equality only (no prefixes, no time ordering). A victim whose own run is missing from the index is still counted as independent and still counts toward `unresolved`.
- **Loops.** The walk keeps a `visited` set, so a loop in the index ends the walk instead of hanging the job.
- **Anchor prose.** The anchor's "Queue depth is not evidence" paragraph now says the chain may pass through green groups. The reading guidance gains one line: a later queue build that went green on the same `main` is a control only if its affected-only selection ran the failing package.
- **Harness** (`scripts/check-merge-queue-triage-outcome.mjs`):
  - New scenario **A18** re-scores the #26247 chain: victim #26064 ← green #26158 ← green #26210 ← victim #26198. Expected: 2 PRs, **1 independent hit**, #26064 as root and #26198 as inherited. It also carries a two-run loop behind main's tip, which the walk must end on and must not fuse.
  - New mutation **M29** stops the walk at its first hop. A18 must go red, and A12 and A13 must stay green as controls.
  - M16's anchor moved to the new lookup line.
  - `queueRun()` takes an optional `conclusion`, so green groups are spelled `success`.

## Evidence

- **Red before the fix.** Commit `f6efe203` adds A18 on top of `origin/main` `be531f68`, with the workflow unchanged. `node scripts/check-merge-queue-triage-outcome.mjs` exits 1 with 4 failed assertions, all A18. The anchor reads `**2 pull requests** … **2 independent hits**`, and both rows show `independent`.
- **Green after the fix** (head `4394d310`):
  - `node scripts/check-merge-queue-triage-outcome.mjs` exits 0: `OK (141 assertions over 35 scenarios …)`.
  - `node scripts/check-merge-queue-triage-outcome.mjs --self-test` exits 0: `187 assertions, 33 mutations of the shipped script each driven to red`. On main this was 34 scenarios and 32 mutations; every original scenario is unchanged and still green.

## Gates

Local subset, measured at head `4394d310`:

- `node scripts/pm/dispatch-gates.mjs --commands --repo objectstack-ai/objectstack` derives **51 commands** for this diff (2 paths, +127/-19 changed lines, under the 3000-line threshold).
- **All 51 ran, and all 51 exited 0.** Each exit code was captured before any pipe, with stdin set to `/dev/null`. That includes `check-merge-queue-triage-outcome` with and without `--self-test`, `check:nul-bytes`, `check:self-test-wired`, `check:workflow-step-name-quoting`, `check:pm-governed-merges` and `check:pm-dispatch-gates` (fast tier: 1899 cases, 575 s).
- `dispatch-gates --ran` reports: `51 derived, 51 run, 0 NOT-MEASURED, 0 UNRUN`. That zero is derived from the recorded exit codes.
- **Not measured locally:**
  - 7 derived families take a value from the workflow (the shard-attestation and test-completeness argvs, `--verify-required-set`) and have no local invocation.
  - The path-scheduled `Test Core` job and the type-check lanes run only in CI.
  - CI on this PR is the reading for all of these.
- **No package touched.** No build or typecheck is owed, and no dogfood (the title has no `!` and there is no `(narrowing)` arm).
- **Changeset:** `skip-changeset`. This changes in-repo tooling only and publishes nothing.

## Acceptance notes

- **The walk also passes through landed history.** A victim's base is usually `main`'s tip, which is itself the head of the queue group that landed it, so the walk keeps going into landed groups inside the 24 h window. That fuses nothing as long as no victim's head ever landed. One case can break that. A CI run that is red only on advisory (non-required) jobs still lands. Its head then sits on `main`, and every later victim with the same key would be read as stacked on it. The old one-hop test already had this exposure for the PR directly behind such a landing; the walk widens it to the rest of the window. I'm noting it here rather than filing it: it is an inference from reading the code, and no real queue run has been seen in that state. No owner is assigned.
- `stackEdges` is still not narrowed to the CI workflow, as before. Other workflows' `merge_group` runs on the same commit share its base and head, so they add the same edge twice and can never add a wrong one.

## 维护者速读(草稿)

- **改了什么**:合并队列分诊工作流里判断「两个被弹出的 PR 是否同一条投机栈」的函数，现在会沿着窗口内所有队列构建(包括中间变绿、没被弹出的那几组)从 base 一路追到 head,追到另一个被弹出 PR 的 head 就算同一栈。原来只看相邻一跳。锚卡阅读指引加了一句：同一 main 上后来变绿的队列构建，只有它的 affected-only 选择真跑到了失败包，才算对照。
- **为什么改**:#26247 上，一次确定性的断裂(#26064 排队提交)被读成了「2 次独立命中」,差点被当成 flaky 交给错的人。原因是中间两组队列构建没选中失败包所以是绿的，旧算法在那里断了链。
- **风险与代价(含回滚)**:只影响锚卡与分诊评论里「独立命中」的计数和 stack 列，不改触发条件(仍是 ≥2 个 PR 就立锚)，不重排、不打标签、不碰任何门禁。不多调 API。可能的偏差方向见 Acceptance notes 第一条(非必需 job 红但落地的构建会让之后同签名的弹出被算成同栈)。回滚就是 revert 本 PR。
- **席位意见**:
- **你要做的**:审阅后用 GOVERNED_APPROVERS 账号批准；批准后由席位落地。
